sloka: कातरत्वम् प्रकाशम् हि सीता अपनयनेन मे ।निवृत्त वन वासः च जनकम् मिथिल अधिपम् ॥३-६२-१२॥
transliteration: kātaratvam prakāśam hi sītā apanayanena me ।nivṛtta vana vāsaḥ ca janakam mithila adhipam ॥3-62-12॥

translations.english: By Sita's abduction it will be clear to the world that I lack manliness and compassion. My cowardly nature will clearly manifest.
